how.title: How it works
how.intro: Donate BTS to the creator of this application
how.intro2: — the top donor of the past 30 days becomes the referrer/registrar for every new account created in this app.
how.topOnly: Only the #1 donor earns the referrer/registrar role. Donors ranked 2–100 are listed here but receive no referral credit.
how.ltm: Lifetime membership required — without an upgraded LTM account your referrals earn you no fees.
how.appOnly: Only accounts created inside this application (create account, faucet method) are attributed to the top donor. Registrations made through other BitShares wallets or interfaces do not count.
how.noGuarantee: Becoming the top donor does not guarantee you any referrals — you must actively invite people to create accounts through this app during the window. If nobody donates, the referrer falls back to the default account:
